sobre.descricao: PDV SV MAXGUI-2 is a point-of-sale (POS) system developed with a focus on organization, security, and technical learning. Created by SER VIVO, the project offers a complete, practical, and modular platform, allowing integration with other systems under the SV brand. This project is currently in Alpha version and is under continuous development. All features have been designed to ensure data security, efficient access control, and reliability in sales processing. The system must not be commercialized or sold. Once it reaches the minimum required level of usability and security, it will be made available to the public on the web, especially for small businesses just getting started, while also remaining available to larger companies. Our goal is to help those starting out succeed, especially those who cannot afford paid POS systems, while striving to create one of the best point-of-sale systems ever made, completely free of charge.
